entries.description: List of birthday/event entries and directives; supports comments, &include directives, and event definitions with optional type and flags. Each entry is a dictionary with optional keys: comment, directive, event. Only one of comment/directive/event may be present per entry. Empty entries are not allowed. See 'entries.items' for structure details below.

entries.items.description: A single entry — either a comment (starting with #), an &include directive, or an event line (name=date[ type][ options...]). Exactly one of comment/directive/event must be present. The others must be omitted or null/empty. See flat fields below for allowed keys and types.

entries.items.comment.description: Text to emit as a comment line (prefixed with '# '). Empty string means no comment.

entries.items.directive.description: An &include directive. Must have name='include' and path to the included file.

entries.items.directive.items.description: Flat directive structure: must include 'name'='include' and 'path' (absolute, no ~).

entries.items.directive.items.name.description: Directive name; only 'include' is supported by the program.

entries.items.directive.items.path.description: Absolute filesystem path of the file to include. Must not use ~ notation.

entries.items.event.description: A birthday/anniversary/event line: name=date[ type][ options...]

entries.items.event.items.description: Event fields. Only 'name', 'date', 'type', and 'options' are used by birthday(1).

entries.items.event.items.date.description: Date in DD/MM, DD/MM/YY, or DD/MM/YYYY format. YY is deprecated and assumed 19xx.

entries.items.event.items.type.description: Event type: 'bd' (birthday), 'ann' (anniversary), or 'ev' (event). Defaults to 'bd' if omitted.

entries.items.event.items.options.description: List of option flags, e.g. ['wn', '21'] or ['todate', '31/12/2025'], 'fordays', '5', etc. May be empty.
